$comment: Generated by tools/build-ui-schema.mjs — edit the table there, then rebuild. Facets F1–F12 are defined in docs/01-taxonomy-and-rules.md.

tier.dynamic: Max tier of the children actually changed

display.mode.label: Display mode
display.mode.help: Choose how the game is shown: one monitor, three monitors, or a VR headset. Other display settings depend on this choice.

os.reason: No headset detected. Connect it and start your OpenXR runtime.

v2.note: is_stereo → vr, is_triple → triple, otherwise single

display.mode.dx12: Mode switch recreates the swapchain(s): one, three child windows, or an OpenXR swapchain pair.

display.monitor.label: Monitor
display.monitor.help: Which display the game opens on.
display.monitor.dx12: Swapchain is recreated on the new output (IDXGIOutput).

display.resolution.label: Resolution
display.resolution.help: Output resolution of the game window.
display.resolution.dx12: ResizeBuffers + every resolution-dependent render target is reallocated.

display.window_mode.label: Window mode
display.window_mode.help: Exclusive fullscreen, borderless window, or a regular window.
display.window_mode.dx12: Fullscreen transition changes the swapchain present model.

display.aspect_ratio.label: Aspect ratio
display.aspect_ratio.help: Aspect ratio of the rendered image. Auto matches the monitor.

display.triple_screen.width.label: Screen width
display.triple_screen.width.help: Visible width of one panel, without bezels.

display.triple_screen.distance.label: Eye-to-screen distance
display.triple_screen.distance.help: Distance from your eyes to the center screen.

display.triple_screen.screen_angle.label: Side screen angle
display.triple_screen.screen_angle.help: Angle of each side screen relative to the center one.

display.triple_screen.bezel.label: Bezel width
display.triple_screen.bezel.help: Bezel width per screen edge. Hides the part of the image that would sit behind it.

display.panini.distance.label: Panini projection
display.panini.distance.help: Reduces stretching at the edges of a wide field of view.

display.panini.vertical_compression.label: Panini vertical compression
display.panini.vertical_compression.help: Straightens vertical lines when Panini projection is on.

vr.pixel_density.label: Pixel density
vr.pixel_density.help: Render resolution as a percentage of the headset runtime recommendation.

vr.foveated_rendering.label: Foveated rendering
vr.foveated_rendering.help: Renders the edge of each lens at lower detail.

vr.eye_tracked_foveated_rendering.label: Eye-tracked foveation
vr.eye_tracked_foveated_rendering.help: Moves the full-detail region to where you are looking.

vr.prefer_framerate_over_latency.label: Prefer frame rate over latency
vr.prefer_framerate_over_latency.help: Allows deeper frame queuing to hold the headset refresh rate.

vr.disable_hidden_area_mask.label: Disable hidden-area mask
vr.disable_hidden_area_mask.help: Renders pixels outside the lens view. For debugging only.

vr.enable_spectator_view.label: Spectator view
vr.enable_spectator_view.help: Mirrors the headset view to the desktop window.

vr.render_to_intermediate_target.label: Render to intermediate target
vr.render_to_intermediate_target.help: Adds a copy step before submitting to the runtime. Can fix compatibility with some runtimes.

vr.log_vr_pacing.label: Log VR frame pacing
vr.log_vr_pacing.help: Writes frame-timing diagnostics to the log.

display.render_resolution.label: Render → output
display.render_resolution.help: The resolution the game renders at internally and the resolution it outputs. Calculated from upscaling, supersampling and display settings.

display.supersampling.label: Supersampling
display.supersampling.help: Renders above the output resolution, then downsamples. Very expensive.
display.supersampling.dx12: Reallocates every resolution-dependent target and rebuilds the downsample PSO.
display.supersampling.note: Factor assumed per axis (1.5x at 4K = 5760×3240, same as the prototype). Confirm with the engine team.

graphics.upscaling.provider.label: Upscaler
graphics.upscaling.provider.help: Renders at a lower resolution and reconstructs the image at your output resolution. The list shows only the technologies this PC can run.

v2.note: Upscaling_DLSS → dlss; Upscaling_FSR → fsr4 if supported else fsr31

graphics.upscaling.provider.dx12: Streamline proxy swapchain persists. Switching unloads one sl feature, loads another and re-tags color/depth/MV/exposure resources via slSetTag. No swapchain recreation.

graphics.upscaling.mode.label: Upscaling mode
graphics.upscaling.mode.help: How much lower the game renders before reconstruction. Each option shows the actual resolution on this PC.
graphics.upscaling.mode.dx12: Preset change resizes tagged inputs within the loaded feature context.

graphics.upscaling.dlss_model.label: DLSS model
graphics.upscaling.dlss_model.help: Which DLSS model the game uses. Driver default follows NVIDIA's recommendation.

graphics.frame_generation.provider.label: Frame generation
graphics.frame_generation.provider.help: Generates extra frames between rendered ones. Motion looks smoother, but latency goes up by about one rendered frame.
graphics.frame_generation.provider.dx12: DLSS-G / FSR FG load as sl features through the resident proxy swapchain. Allocates interpolated-frame buffers and enables latency markers.

graphics.frame_generation.multiplier.label: Frame generation multiplier
graphics.frame_generation.multiplier.dx12: Changes the count of interpolated buffers within the loaded FG feature.

graphics.latency.mode.label: Latency reduction
graphics.latency.mode.help: Shortens the queue of frames waiting for the GPU, so your inputs reach the screen sooner.
graphics.latency.mode.dx12: sl.reflex marker insertion via the shared proxy (no NVAPI pipeline reinit).

display.v_sync.label: V-Sync
display.v_sync.help: Waits for the display refresh before showing a frame. Prevents tearing but adds latency. With VRR, Off plus a frame cap is usually best.

reclassified.why: DX12 flip model: sync interval is a Present() argument (tearing support is decided once at swapchain creation), so this needs no rebuild. Confirm with the engine team.

display.frame_rate_limit.gameplay_frame_.label: Frame rate limit
display.frame_rate_limit.gameplay_frame_.help: Caps frames per second while driving.
display.frame_rate_limit.gameplay_frame_.editableNote: Allowed in the live HUD because its effect shows up in the perf strip.

display.frame_rate_limit.occluded_frame_.label: Background frame rate limit
display.frame_rate_limit.occluded_frame_.help: Caps frames per second when the window is hidden or not focused.

display.frame_rate_limit.menu_frame_rate.label: Limit frame rate in menus
display.frame_rate_limit.menu_frame_rate.help: Caps menus at a lower rate to save power and reduce heat.

display.physics_late_latching.label: Physics late latching
display.physics_late_latching.help: Samples the newest physics state just before rendering, which lowers perceived input latency.

graphics.overallGraphics.label: Quality preset
graphics.overallGraphics.help: Sets the detail settings below in one step. Changing any of them switches the preset to Custom.
graphics.overallGraphics.note: Apply tier is dynamic: the cost is the highest tier among the children the preset actually changes (R6, R9).

graphics.msaa.label: MSAA
graphics.msaa.help: Multi-sample anti-aliasing for geometry edges. Works alongside an upscaler.
graphics.msaa.dx12: Sample count is baked into render-target formats and PSOs, so a full PSO rebuild is needed.

graphics.antialising.filmicAntialiasing..label: Temporal AA
graphics.antialising.filmicAntialiasing..help: The engine's temporal anti-aliasing filter. Soft reduces shimmer; Sharp keeps more detail.

graphics.antialising.fxaa.enable.label: FXAA
graphics.antialising.fxaa.enable.help: Cheap post-process edge smoothing. Slightly blurs the image.

graphics.sharpening.strength.label: Sharpening
graphics.sharpening.strength.help: Restores detail softened by upscaling and temporal AA.

graphics.textureQuality.label: Texture quality
graphics.textureQuality.help: Resolution of surface textures. Mostly uses VRAM.
graphics.textureQuality.dx12: Streaming mip ranges and descriptor heaps are rebuilt.

graphics.texturePoolSize.label: Texture streaming pool
graphics.texturePoolSize.help: VRAM reserved for streaming textures. Larger pools mean less pop-in but need more VRAM.

graphics.anisotropicFiltering.anisotropi.label: Anisotropic filtering
graphics.anisotropicFiltering.anisotropi.help: Keeps textures sharp at glancing angles, such as the road ahead.
graphics.anisotropicFiltering.anisotropi.dx12: Static samplers are baked into root signatures, so a root-signature/PSO rebuild is needed.

graphics.anisotropicFiltering.customSett.label: Mip bias — main
graphics.anisotropicFiltering.customSett.help: Negative values sharpen textures but increase shimmer.

graphics.viewDistance.quality.label: View distance
graphics.viewDistance.quality.help: How far scenery, objects and shadows are drawn. Mostly costs CPU time.

graphics.levelOfDetail.levelOfDetail.label: Level of detail
graphics.levelOfDetail.levelOfDetail.help: How soon models switch to simpler versions as they move away.

graphics.levelOfDetail.experimentalStati.label: Static LOD (experimental)
graphics.levelOfDetail.experimentalStati.help: Uses fixed LOD levels for static scenery instead of distance-based switching.

graphics.shadow.shadowQuality.label: Shadow quality
graphics.shadow.shadowQuality.help: Resolution and filtering of world shadows.

graphics.ambientOcclusionType.label: Ambient occlusion technique
graphics.ambientOcclusionType.help: Screen-space (SSAO) or ray traced (RTAO). RTAO is more accurate and much more expensive.
graphics.ambientOcclusionType.dx12: RTAO needs BLAS/TLAS builds and a DXR pipeline state object.

graphics.giUpdateFrequency.label: Global illumination updates
graphics.giUpdateFrequency.help: How often bounced light is recalculated as time of day and weather change.

graphics.enviromentReflection.label: Environment reflections
graphics.enviromentReflection.help: Quality of reflections on the world (not on cars).

graphics.clouds.cloudsCustomSettings.ren.label: Cloud update spread (frames)
graphics.clouds.cloudsCustomSettings.ren.help: Spreads cloud rendering across N frames. Higher is cheaper but may smear when clouds move fast.

graphics.particles.essential.label: Essential particles only
graphics.particles.essential.help: Keeps only particles that matter for driving, such as tyre smoke and spray from cars ahead.

graphics.mirror.mirror_mode.label: Mirrors
graphics.mirror.mirror_mode.help: Off, one combined mirror render, or separate renders for each mirror.
graphics.mirror.mirror_mode.dx12: Mirror render targets and their pass graph are rebuilt.

graphics.mirror.alternate_rendering.label: Alternate-frame mirrors
graphics.mirror.alternate_rendering.help: Updates mirrors every other frame. Halves their cost, but mirror motion is less smooth.

graphics.vehicleLevelOfDetail.label: Vehicle detail
graphics.vehicleLevelOfDetail.help: Model detail of the other cars.

graphics.carReflection.carReflectionQual.label: Car reflections
graphics.carReflection.carReflectionQual.help: Reflection cubemaps on car bodies and the cockpit.

graphics.car_visibility.max_ahead_car.label: Cars drawn ahead
graphics.car_visibility.max_ahead_car.help: Maximum number of cars rendered in front of you. Large grids are CPU-heavy.

graphics.num_dash_displays.label: Live dashboard screens
graphics.num_dash_displays.help: How many in-car digital displays are rendered live.
graphics.num_dash_displays.dx12: Dash render targets are allocated at init.

graphics.post_processing_preset.label: Post-process style
graphics.post_processing_preset.note: Placeholder option list. The real presets come from the engine's post-process library.

graphics.exposureBias.label: Exposure
graphics.exposureBias.help: Overall brightness compensation in EV stops.

graphics.exposureFusion.label: Exposure fusion
graphics.exposureFusion.help: Local tone compression. Recovers detail in bright skies and dark cockpits.

graphics.photoLook.label: Photo look
graphics.photoLook.help: A lightweight filter that pushes the final image toward a photographic look. Much cheaper than neural rendering and runs on any GPU.

graphics.veil.label: Veiling glare
graphics.veil.help: Simulates glare scattering in the eye or lens.

graphics.neural_rendering.mode.label: Neural rendering
graphics.neural_rendering.mode.help: DLSS 5 neural rendering. An AI model reworks the final image for more lifelike lighting and materials. It runs on the final output, whatever upscaler is used, and costs a lot of GPU time.
graphics.neural_rendering.mode.dx12: Loads or unloads the Streamline sl.dlss_nr feature on the resident proxy swapchain. Assumed quick reload; confirm in game.
graphics.neural_rendering.mode.note: Off / Performance / Quality is provisional. Cost multipliers are guesses.

graphics.neural_rendering.intensity.label: Neural rendering intensity
graphics.neural_rendering.intensity.help: How strongly the neural result replaces the rendered image.

graphics.neural_rendering.tone_strength.label: Tone strength
graphics.neural_rendering.tone_strength.help: How much the model changes lighting and color tone.

graphics.neural_rendering.structure_stre.label: Structure strength
graphics.neural_rendering.structure_stre.help: How much the model changes surface detail.

graphics.neural_rendering.skin_structure.label: Skin structure strength
graphics.neural_rendering.skin_structure.help: Structure strength on skin, such as drivers and crew.

graphics.neural_rendering.auto_mask.label: Automatic masking
graphics.neural_rendering.auto_mask.help: Lets the model pick out regions to treat separately.

graphics.neural_rendering.performance_mo.label: Neural rendering performance
graphics.neural_rendering.performance_mo.help: Trades neural rendering detail for speed.
graphics.neural_rendering.performance_mo.note: Provisional list; only Ultra Quality is confirmed.

graphics.depthOfField.label: Depth of field
graphics.depthOfField.help: Blurs things outside the focus distance (replays and photo mode).

graphics.motionBlur.centralClarity.label: Motion blur center clarity
graphics.motionBlur.centralClarity.help: Keeps the center of the screen sharp while the edges blur.

vr.sunglasses.label: Sunglasses
vr.sunglasses.help: Darkens the image in the headset for comfort in bright scenes.

vr.world_scale.label: World scale
vr.world_scale.help: Perceived size of the world. 1.0 is real-world scale.
